family.description: This entry represents a domain (previously known as DUF2423) found N-terminal in YBL028C ribosome biogenesis factor and related fungal protein [[cite:PUB00100535],[cite:PUB00154332],[cite:PUB00154333]]. This domain adopts an alpha-helix and makes extensive contacts with the ribosomal protein uL3 and rRNA.
family.name: YBL028C ribosome biogenesis factor, N-terminal domain
